description: Resume normal answering and AI text replies on one prepaid line you own. Use line_id from get_answering_line. While paused, callers hear "This line is not taking calls right now. Please try again later." and the call ends without AI, usage charges or owner alerts; missed callers appear as paused in call history. Direct SIP is rejected at personalization; the carrier controls its rejection announcement. STOP, START and HELP still work. The prepaid balance and number are kept: no charge, refund or expiry. Already live returns already without writing; setting-up, closed, agency and subscription lines are refused. close_answering_line ends answering and keeps the unused balance recorded. Needs lines:manage; rate limited per account and line. Returns line_id, status, paused_at, already and message.

line_id.description: An owned prepaid line_id from get_answering_line.
